paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines

annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the distribution of polarity scores, represented on the x-axis and their corresponding counts on the y-axis. The x-axis is labeled “Polarity scores,” using a linear scale that ranges from -1.0 to 0.6 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2 units, and it does not specify any units. The y-axis is labeled “Counts”, also utilizing a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50000 with tick labels at intervals of 10000 units. A single line is depicted in blue with circular markers and a solid line style. Starting near the origin, the line remains relatively flat with low counts up to approximately -0.6 on the x-axis. It then gradually increases, reaching around 10000 counts at -0.4 polarity score, followed by a steeper climb peaking at 50000 counts near zero polarity score. A sharp decline follows, leading to a second smaller peak of about 27000 counts at approximately 0.2 polarity score. The line continues with a downward trend exhibiting minor fluctuations, with notable markers around 10000 at 0.3 and falling towards 0 near 0.6 on the x-axis.
